title: Patch: a Tribute hand hint showing how many Tributes a card needs
thread:
**Issue #2268 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2268: Patch: a Tribute hand hint showing how many Tributes a card needs
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

On the viewer's own hand cards that have a Tribute cost (SPEC §6.3 "Tribute X", R41, R428), show a small Tribute pip with the number of Tributes the card needs **right now**, using the hand hint system from #2267. It is a single entry in the hint list plus its icon, drawn exactly like any other hint: tiny, in the corner, no motion. Players read Sacrifice as Tribute (R373), so the label says "Tribute".

**The number comes from the engine, not the printed text.** X changes after printing: each Float the owner makes lowers it by 1, never below 0 (R1841003, `float::tribute_lowered`), and a Nerf or Buff can move it (R386, "Tribute: less is better"). The client must not work it out itself (CLAUDE.md rule 7). The view does not carry it yet (there is no tribute field on `CardView`), so:

1. **Engine:** add `tribute?: number` to `CardView` (view_for.rs / instance_view.rs, wherever the hand card's other view-only numbers such as `embiggenCost` are set). Set it only on a card in the **viewer's own hand** whose Tribute cost is a play cost, using `play_choices::tribute_cost_of(state, card)`, and only when that value is above 0. Leave it absent everywhere else (opponent's hand, field, deck), so no hidden information leaks (§10.8). Doc-comment it the way its neighbours are documented (SPEC section and ruling).
2. **Wire:** run `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` to regenerate `apps/web/src/wire/generated/CardView.ts`, and commit the diff.
3. **Spec:** if §10.8 lists what `CardView` carries, add the field there. If this is a decision the spec does not make, write the ruling note in this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3, `docs/issues-and-patches.md` Ruling numbers) with a proving test named after it.
4. **Client:** a `tribute` hint in the hint list from #2267: `applies` returns `{ n: card.tribute, label }` when `card.tribute` is set and null otherwise. The icon is a small sacrificial or altar mark in `cards/icons.tsx`'s style.

Unit worth (the Sheep Token counting 2 or 3, "Worth N Tributes", §3.2, §7) does not change the number shown: it is the X the card asks for, as the Tribute prompt's `min` is.

## Acceptance

- An engine test (testkit `scenario()`): a hand card with Tribute 2 has `tribute == Some(2)` in its owner's view; after one Float by its owner, `Some(1)`; after two, absent (0); the opponent's view of the same hand has no tribute (it is a count anyway); a card without a Tribute cost has none; the same card on the field has none.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, the full `cargo test` line above (wire regenerated and committed) and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.
- A vitest test: the hint shows `2` on a hand card whose view has `tribute: 2`, and is absent when the field is absent.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes (this changes no card's play, so no pending fragment).

## Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2267
```
